subject.title: Message plugin: support Telegram forum topic management (create/edit/close/reopen)

question: Should Telegram topic close, reopen, and permanent delete become distinct public message actions with permission-specific configuration gates and defaults?
rationale: Current contracts expose none of these operations, and Telegram deletion has materially different permissions and destructive consequences from close and reopen.

options.title: Distinct lifecycle actions
options.body: Add topic-close, topic-reopen, and topic-delete with explicit Telegram-owned gates, permission-specific errors, and prominent destructive-delete documentation.

options.title: Reuse existing actions
options.body: Overload edit and delete based on topic identifiers, reducing action names but creating ambiguous public semantics and permission handling.

options.title: Defer permanent deletion
options.body: Add close and reopen first while leaving deletion unsupported until its irreversible message removal is separately approved.

recommendation.title: Distinct lifecycle actions
recommendation.body: Add topic-close, topic-reopen, and topic-delete with explicit Telegram-owned gates, permission-specific errors, and prominent destructive-delete documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history introduced topic-edit and normalized the Telegram action contract that this decision would extend.
